responsibility: Platform-configuration header for GNAT sockets support. It decides whether sockets are available, arranges prerequisite feature-test macros and target includes, maps Windows socket error codes and shutdown constants to portable names, declares thread-safety properties of gethost/getserv interfaces, and defines capability macros used both by socket.c and by generated OS-constants code. It is the compile-time portability contract for GNAT.Sockets’ C bindings.
